correctness.rationale: The finite theorem was independently replayed from the actual package certificate rather than trusted from a saved log. Using the published permutation generators and two facet seeds, the audit reconstructed a group of order 54, exactly 36 facets, and face vector \((9,36,84,90,36)\). It then enumerated all 510 nonempty proper vertex sets. There are exactly 255 faces and 255 nonfaces, with nonface counts \(36,90,84,36,9\) in sizes 4 through 8. For every one of the 255 certificate rows, each listed pair was checked on the evolving induced complex: the upper simplex was maximal, the lower simplex was codimension one and belonged to no other maximal simplex, and after every deletion the residue was exactly the four-triangle boundary of a tetrahedron. The independently replayed collapse-length distribution is exactly the one stated in the claim.
residual_risks: The result is a finite theorem about the standard published nine-vertex combinatorial model; no claim transfers to other triangulations.

originality.rationale: The closest exact-object literature gives complementarity, uniqueness, face/incidence structure, and the fact that the complement of a facet induces a four-vertex two-sphere. The complete 2001 article text available through a public transcription was inspected: it develops amicable partitions and uses a different vertex-collapse operation on auxiliary spheres, but contains no occurrence of an induced-subcomplex collapse theorem and no all-proper-subset simple-homotopy dichotomy. Resultary's only exact semantic hit for the all-nonface collapse statement was the assigned finding. The larger 5--8-vertex nonface reductions therefore remain a genuine additional finite classification rather than an implication of homology injectivity or complementarity alone.
residual_risks: The long Arnoux--Marin crystallographic treatment remains a plausible older priority source not fully inspected in this run.
Poorly indexed computational notes could contain the same finite collapse census.

value.rationale: Induced subcomplexes are intrinsic to tight triangulations, and the nine-vertex \(\mathbb{CP}^2\) is a canonical minimal object. A complete face-versus-sphere simple-homotopy classification of every proper induced subcomplex, with replayable elementary-collapse witnesses, is a natural structural finite theorem.
residual_risks: The result is object-specific and does not assert a general CP2 triangulation theorem.

limitations: Specific to Kühnel's standard nine-vertex triangulation.
